The Super Electric Toothbrush is the only electric toothbrush with augmented reality technology currently available on Amazon. Makes it fun for kids to brush their teeth; recommended for children ages 7+. Kids should brush teeth and gums twice a day for two minutes, and floss once a day. To use: Push the On/Off button to activate vibrations. 1 AA battery included. To replace battery, unscrew battery cover at bottom handle. Remove old battery and discard. Insert new AA battery and replace battery cover.
